name: Richard Plastics Co
old_description: Richard Plastics Co. is a state of the art custom injection molding facility
about:
Richard Plastics Co. has operated from Laurel, Mississippi since 1948, when it was founded to supply custom injection-molded thermoplastic parts at affordable prices. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The 22,700-square-foot facility houses computer-controlled Milacron molding machines that run small to medium production runs, from a few hundred parts up to hundreds of thousands. In-house capabilities include custom injection molding of thermoplastics, on-site mold building and repair through a comprehensive toolroom, and secondary operations such as assembly, hot stamping, heat transfer, machining, and pad printing.

The molder serves customers in furniture, water-valve, and precision military-component sectors, working from design sketches through finished parts. Its toolroom can refine existing mold designs or develop new ones to improve cost efficiency.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery, competitive pricing, and a quality system aimed at defect-free parts, citing decades-long customer relationships as evidence of its reliability.

name: Richards Sheet Metal
old_description: Richards Sheet Metal is no ordinary company. Founded in 1928, Richards has served a wide range of industries in need of world-class metal work, including fabrication,
about:
Richards Sheet Metal was founded in 1928 in Ogden, Utah. The company has operated continuously for nearly a century, though the original founders are not named in available sources.

The company operates a 90,000-square-foot facility where it provides a range of metal fabrication services. These include flat sheet laser cutting, tube laser cutting, CNC/turret punching, precision sheet metal forming, welding (with certified welders and orbital welding capability), architectural and decorative sheet metal fabrication, field services, painting and coating systems, tool design, prototyping, and stamping. Richards handles both one-off parts and mass-produced components.

Its customer base spans transportation, waste management, military and government, mining, food services and sanitation, machinery, construction and architectural, institutional and recreational, pharmaceuticals, general industrial, farming, and entrepreneurial start-ups.

Richards positions itself as a total solution for quality metal fabrication, emphasizing its state-of-the-art facility and ability to deliver innovative solutions that exceed performance and quality expectations.

name: Righteous
old_description: Apparel Fulfillment Services Built for Growth, Backed by Real People
about:
Righteous began in the late 1980s when Aly and Rick Salz, frustrated by inconsistent quality and unreliable vendors in the corporate apparel market, launched Righteous Clothing Agency in Pasadena, California. The company later moved its headquarters to Clackamas, Oregon, where it operates today.

Today Righteous operates as a full-service apparel partner, handling custom screen printing, embroidery, design, warehousing, kitting, and fulfillment through a dual-warehouse network in Oregon and Missouri. The company manages online company stores for clients ranging from small teams to enterprises with thousands of employees, processing orders with real-time inventory and shipping in-stock items within two days. A staff of around 1,000 supports end-to-end program management, from creative design to nationwide distribution.

Righteous serves clients across restaurants and food service, industrial manufacturing and construction, healthcare, education, and grocery and convenience sectors. Its customer base includes multi-location restaurant chains such as Farrelli’s Pizza and Elmer’s Restaurants, construction firms like Pence Contractors, healthcare networks such as PeaceHealth, and brands including Dave & Buster’s, Great Harvest, and Craveworthy Brands.

The company was founded to solve the problem of messy printing, crooked logos, and vendors who disappointed when it mattered most. Righteous differentiates itself by assigning a dedicated account manager to each client, providing real-time inventory visibility, and managing the entire workflow from design through fulfillment so clients don’t have to juggle multiple vendors.

name: Rimer & Rimer Plastic Division
old_description: We offer injection molding services throughout the southeast US. We process most commercially available thermoplastics.
about:
Rimer & Rimer Plastic Division operates from Bradenton, Florida, where it was founded in 1989. The company has remained family-owned for over three decades, building a reputation as a dependable supplier of custom injection molding services across the southeastern United States.

The facility spans 25,000 square feet of dedicated manufacturing space and houses 14 injection molding machines ranging from 75 to 770 U.S. tons, with shot capacities from 3 to 128 ounces. Core processes include injection molding, insert molding, over molding, blade and insert molding, magnetic additive molding, custom color and effects molding, and molding of X-ray detectable, metal detectable, and thermally conductive plastics. The company also provides tooling and part design, R&D tooling and sampling, assembly from basic to complex, and packaging design.

Rimer & Rimer serves a broad customer base in consumer goods — lawn and garden, pool equipment, kitchenware, sporting goods, and musical accessories — as well as construction and agriculture markets with window and door components, HVAC parts, and heavy equipment assemblies. Rescue and safety equipment manufacturers rely on the shop for strobe light components, over-molded knives and sheaths, buckles, harnesses, housings, guards, and shields. The company emphasizes its specialization in hard-to-mold materials.

The firm distinguishes itself by offering a wider range of part sizes than most molders in the state, often acting as a single source for all injection molding needs. Its stated focus on difficult materials, combined with in-house assembly and packaging, aims to reduce supply-chain complexity for customers.

name: Rio Puerco Woodworks
old_description: Rio Puerco Woodworks specializes in custom hand-crafted doors for homes and businesses in Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, Santa Fe, and surrounding areas. Our craftsman Jack Haring creates one-of-a-kind interior and exterior wooden doors. He can bring to life your design or help you create the centerpiece door you’ve been looking for.
about:
Rio Puerco Woodworks is based in Rio Rancho, New Mexico. The business remains owner-operated by Haring.

The company produces custom hand-crafted interior and exterior doors for residential and commercial clients across the Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, and Santa Fe areas. Each door is built to order, with Haring working directly with customers to develop designs that range from traditional panel doors to complex arched entries for circular rooms. The shop also offers custom furniture pieces, though doors remain the core focus.

Rio Puerco serves homeowners, builders, and commercial contractors who need one-of-a-kind architectural woodwork. Past projects have included distinctive challenges such as an arched front door for a circular entry room, and the company’s work has been featured in regional newspapers and magazines. Clients typically engage through design consultations at the Rio Rancho workshop.

Haring emphasizes a collaborative approach, guiding clients from concept through fabrication to create personalized centerpiece doors. The business was founded on his desire to apply engineering-minded precision to artistic woodworking, a philosophy that continues to drive each project.

name: Ripon Athletic
old_description: Ripon Athletic is a custom manufacturer of athletic apparel, uniforms and jackets. Our brands include Ripon Athletic uniforms and apparel, Ripon Jacket and the legendary Sand Knit brand. We are looking for people to help create top quality apparel to support our growth. We take pride in our 100% made in USA products. We offer competitive pay, health/dental/life insurance, paid holidays and vacations, 401K retirement plan, profit sharing and flexible scheduling.
about:
Ripon Athletic, based in Berlin, Wisconsin, has been manufacturing athletic apparel for over a century. The company was founded by Hank Derleth and operates under the Sand‑Knit, Ripon Athletic, and Ripon Jacket brands.

The company produces custom uniforms, award jackets, vinyl jackets, and accessories for teams at every level, from youth leagues to professional organizations. Manufacturing is done domestically in its Berlin facility, where the team handles custom pattern development, separate men’s and women’s fits, and extended sizing including shorts, oversizes, and longs.

Ripon Athletic serves the team‑sports market across youth, scholastic, and professional ranks. Its customers include team dealers, equipment managers, and athletic programs; testimonials cite professional equipment managers and dealers who rely on the company’s live customer‑service model.

The business emphasizes its 100 % U.S.‑made heritage and a service philosophy summed up by founder Hank Derleth’s “golden rule” approach: immediate live‑person support, custom flexibility, and a commitment to quality that has sustained the Sand‑Knit name for a hundred years.

Risen Medical, LLC was founded in 2017 in the greater Portland, Oregon metropolitan area and now operates from Bend, Oregon. The company was established to serve physicians and their patients, with team members located across Oregon, Idaho, and Washington.

The company provides a range of medical technology and services to clinics, including multiple spine surgical systems, spine implants, biologic and bone graft products, and durable medical equipment (DME) services such as bone growth stimulation, bracing, and CPAP therapy. Risen Medical partners with suppliers like Aspen Medical Products, Orthofix Medical, Advanced Orthopedics, React Health, and Fisher & Paykel to offer CPAP/APAP devices, bone growth therapy, cold therapy, continuous passive motion units, spine hardware, and spine navigation systems.

Risen Medical serves orthopedic and spine surgery clinics, sleep therapy providers, and broader healthcare facilities in the Pacific Northwest. Its customer base includes physicians and clinics seeking integrated DME solutions and surgical implant support.

The company states its mission is achieving optimum patient outcomes by providing cutting‑edge medical technology and service to providers and patients, positioning itself as a valuable addition to clinic teams.

name: Ritec Inc
old_description: 03.04.21 - RITEC is now offering a modestly priced 8 hour remote training program to help our customers take full advantage of their RAM or SNAP system.
about:
Ritec Inc. is based in Warwick, Rhode Island, and was formed in 1988 by Gary Petersen and Bruce Chick. The founders, who together brought more than 90 years of experience in ultrasonic instrumentation, set out to develop sophisticated computer-controlled instruments for the rapidly expanding field of ultrasonic non-destructive evaluation (NDE) of materials.

The company designs and manufactures complete computer-controlled ultrasonic systems — including its RAM and SNAP product lines — as well as single-function instruments and accessories. A carefully controlled production environment supports a modular product architecture, and the company notes that more than half of all sales involve some degree of custom modification to meet specific application requirements.

Ritec serves customers in aerospace, materials research, government laboratories, and industrial NDE. Its client roster includes collaborations with NASA, the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Johns Hopkins University, the University of Osaka, and private firms such as EMAT Ultrasonics and Matec Applied Sciences. These relationships have produced joint publications and award-winning technical papers.

Ritec’s stated philosophy centers on close collaboration with users during product definition, resulting in instruments that remain at the forefront of technology. Long-standing agreements — including a CRADA with NIST spanning more than five years and a memorandum of agreement with NASA — underpin ongoing instrument upgrades. The company also offers an eight-hour remote training program to help customers maximize the capability of their RAM or SNAP systems.

name: Ritronics Inc
about:
Ritronics Inc was established in 2011 in Warwick, Rhode Island, to serve the aerospace, defense, and transportation sectors with ruggedized power supplies. The privately held company began with a focus on high‑reliability power electronics for mission‑critical platforms.

The company designs and manufactures standard COTS and custom AC/DC and DC/DC power supplies ranging from 36 W to 1,000 W, built to withstand extreme temperatures, shock, vibration, and EMI‑dense environments. Its engineering team handles requirements analysis, topology selection, prototype development, design validation, and environmental and EMI/EMC test support, scaling to production with full traceability. Ritronics also provides third‑party logistics services — procurement, kitting, warehousing, and assembly — through its sister company, Calgreg Electronics.

Ritronics serves defense primes, program managers, and design engineers across aerospace, defense, and transportation markets. Its products are qualified to MIL‑STD‑461G for electromagnetic compatibility and meet FCC Part 15 Class B and CISPR 22.2 Class A requirements, supporting programs with decades‑long lifecycles.

The firm emphasizes domestic engineering and manufacturing oversight, direct engineer‑to‑engineer access without call centers or distributors, and standards‑mapped documentation to streamline qualification. It was founded to solve power problems that off‑the‑shelf suppliers won’t touch, offering long‑lifecycle support for programs measured in decades rather than product cycles.

name: Riverton Sheet Metal Works, Inc
old_description: Riverton Sheet Metal was established in 1919 during the days of Prohibition and unpaved streets.
about:
Riverton Sheet Metal Works, Inc. was founded in 1919 in Riverton, Wyoming, during the Prohibition era. The company remains family-owned, tracing its roots to a founder known as "F.B.," who reportedly built copper stills to support his family. That early ingenuity established a tradition of custom metalwork that continues today.

The firm operates as a full-service HVAC contractor and sheet metal fabricator. It sells and installs residential and commercial heating and cooling equipment from brands such as Lennox, York, Bosch, Aprilaire, Rinnai, and WaterFurnace, including geothermal systems. In-house fabrication is performed on a plasma computer-operated table, producing custom ductwork, fittings, and other sheet metal components. The company also supplies humidifiers, ventilation insulation, and parts, and uses proprietary sizing software to tailor equipment to each job.

Customers include homeowners and commercial builders seeking HVAC installation, replacement, or custom sheet metal work. The company serves the renewable energy and geothermal markets, and its product lines carry Energy Star ratings. Past installations span residential and commercial projects throughout the region.

Riverton Sheet Metal distinguishes itself with a "if you can draw it, we can probably build it" approach to custom fabrication, combining decades-old craftsmanship with modern plasma cutting and digital sizing tools. The family-owned structure emphasizes direct customer service and after-sale support.
